derivation: apparently from the base of G3796 (ὀψέ) and G5610 (ὥρα);
def: properly, even-tide of the (summer) season (dog-days), i.e. (by implication) ripe fruit

occurrences.text: And the fruits that thy soul lusted after are departed from thee, and all things which were dainty and goodly are departed from thee, and thou shalt find them no more at all.
